chain.title: Shelves From the Shallows
chain.desc: A prismarine bookshelf worth 1.5 eterna and 2 arcana per shelf; the ocean route to a level 45 enchanting table.

chain.title: Bookcases Cast in Fire
chain.desc: The Nether counterpart to the Seashelf, worth 1.5 eterna and 3 quanta, and the other route to level 45.

chain.title: Steeped in Sea Magic
chain.desc: Made by infusion enchanting a Seashelf at a level 45 table; raises max eterna from 22.5 to 27.

chain.title: Steeped in Hellfire
chain.desc: The infusion-enchanted Hellshelf; together with its Sea twin it carries a table from level 45 to level 60.

chain.title: A Spyglass on the Enchantment
chain.desc: Built from a Gold Block, a Spyglass, a Night Vision potion and an Infused Hellshelf; grants one extra enchantment clue.

chain.title: Bending Chance Toward You
chain.desc: An Amethyst Block, Honeycomb Block and Infused Seashelf press ten points of rectification onto the table's quanta rolls.

chain.title: Ledger of Every Enchantment
chain.desc: An Ender Chest, an Enchanting Table and infused shelves become a store that banks enchantment levels up to sixteen.

chain.title: Not Merely a Diamond
chain.desc: Apothic Gems drop from chest loot and, rarely, from mobs slain by a real player, with bosses the richest source.

chain.title: Crushed Under the Anvil
chain.desc: Made by dropping any Apothic Gem in the world and letting a falling Anvil land on it.

chain.title: Breaking Down the Spoils
chain.desc: Copper, Gem Dust, a Smithing Table, a Lava Bucket and a piston reduce affix gear back into Rarity Materials.

chain.title: Slate Threaded With Dust
chain.desc: Deepslate ringed with Gem Dust; the plate every Sigil is stamped from.

chain.title: The Lapidary's Bench
chain.desc: Smooth Stone, Shears, planks and Gem Dust build the bench that upgrades a Gem using dust, a twin Gem and Rarity Materials.

chain.title: Rolling the Dice Again
chain.desc: Iron, Gem Dust, an Enchanting Table and Smooth Stone reforge any item with fresh affixes up to Rare rarity.

chain.title: Deepslate That Has Not Woken
chain.desc: Deepslate around a Book, craftable once you hold a level 60 table; it is only the unfinished shell of a Deepshelf.

chain.title: Roused From the Deepslate
chain.desc: Infusion enchanting the Dormant Deepshelf yields 2.5 eterna, 5 quanta and 5 arcana, carrying the table to level 70.

chain.title: Where the Cursed Books Live
chain.desc: A Deepshelf variant that makes treasure enchantments, curses included, appear in the enchanting table.

chain.title: Torn From the Silence
chain.desc: A global loot modifier attaches this tendril to the Warden's death drop; nothing else yields it.

chain.title: Sculk That Answers Back
chain.desc: Warden Tendril, Sculk, a Sculk Catalyst and an Echoing Deepshelf make a 5 eterna, 15 arcana shelf for level 80.

chain.title: Distilled Dragon's Breath
chain.desc: Infusion enchanting at a level 80 table condenses Dragon's Breath into the core reagent of every Endshelf.

chain.title: End Stone and Pearl
chain.desc: End Stone Bricks, an Ender Pearl, a bookshelf and Infused Breath; max eterna climbs to 45.

chain.title: Pearlescent Archive
chain.desc: The upgraded Endshelf, worth 5 eterna with 7.5 quanta and arcana apiece, and the backbone of a level 90 table.

chain.title: One Shelf, Ten Levels
chain.desc: Built around a Dragon Head from the outer End; a single shelf supplies 10 eterna and takes a table from 90 to 100.

chain.title: Reforging Without Limit
chain.desc: Netherite, Arcane Sands and Nether Bricks upgrade the Simple Reforging Table so it can reroll Epic gear and above.

chain.title: Focusing a Nether Star
chain.desc: A Nether Star focused through two Godforged Pearls onto an Enchanting Table; the endgame bench that upgrades or rerolls one affix at a time.

notes: Item set = 104 stems of assets/apotheosis/models/item/*.json intersected with item./block. keys across every assets/*/lang/en_us.json in the jar (76 ids), plus apotheosis:gem, which has models/item/gem.json and is named through item.apotheosis.gem.<gemid> subkeys rather than a bare key. Ladder derived from data/apotheosis/enchanting_stats/*.json (eterna/maxEterna per shelf: seashelf and hellshelf 1.5/22.5, infused 1.75/27, deepshelf 2.5/35, endshelf 2.5/45, pearl_endshelf and sculkshelves 5, draconic_endshelf 10/50), data/apotheosis/recipes/** and the in-jar Patchouli book assets/apotheosis/patchouli_books/apoth_chronicle/en_us (progression/levels1_30 through levels80_100 confirm the 45 / 60 / 70 / 75 / 80 / 90 / 100 breakpoints and that level 80 requires slaying the Warden). Rarity materials and their salvage sources come from data/apotheosis/recipes/salvaging/*.json and data/apotheosis/rarities/*.json (common, uncommon, rare, epic, mythic, ancient). apotheosis:warden_tendril is confirmed as a Warden-only drop by data/apotheosis/loot_modifiers/warden_tendril.json registered in data/forge/loot_modifiers/global_loot_modifiers.json. Nothing dropped. moddb agreement: seashelf, hellshelf, gem, gem_dust, gem_fused_slate, infused_seashelf, infused_hellshelf, dormant_deepshelf, salvaging_table, library, gem_cutting_table and the rarity materials all appear in moddb's 26-entry ordering and the relative order matches. Conflict: moddb puts apotheosis:gem first at pos 0.033, ahead of the shelves, while the recipe/enchanting graph has no gem prerequisite at all - gems are pure loot, so the moddb position is a UI placement rather than a gate; this chain places gem at step 8 where the Gem Dust / Gem Cutting Table branch begins. moddb also ranks apotheosis:mythic_material at 0.313, far ahead of rare_material (0.420) and epic_material (0.455), which contradicts the salvaging rarity ladder; the collection uses the rarity order from data/apotheosis/rarities/.
